profile.headline: Software Engineer @ LinkedIn
profile.summary: I'm a builder at heart - of relationships, systems, and solutions. I began my career in sales, where I learned the art of listening deeply, identifying needs, and creating tailored strategies that delivered real value. That instinct for connection and impact led me into partnerships, where I thrived at the intersection of community, storytelling, and strategic growth. Along the way, I became increasingly drawn to the technical side of the products and communities I was supporting. That curiosity evolved into a new chapter as a software engineer at LinkedIn, where I’ve spent the last several years developing backend systems, driving internal tooling initiatives, and leading cross-functional projects that improve the developer experience.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineer - Internal Tools, LinkedIn Marketing Services

Technologies and Tools:
- Java, Python, SQL
- Protobuf, gRPC
- Developer Onboarding Tools, StackOverflow (internal)
- Developer Productivity Tools, Legacy Code

Key Concepts:
- Backend Development
- API Authorization Standards
- Developer Experience, Internal Tooling, Developer Enablement
- Observability
- System Design
- Stakeholder Collaboration
- Distributed Systems, Asynchronous Processing Infrastructure
- Cross-Functional Documentation
- Tech Debt Management
- Functional Programming

Major Projects:
- Internal Documentation Migration: Served as the engineering lead in the migration from Confluence to LinkedIn's internal StackOverflow platform, streamlining knowledge sharing across engineering teams and improving developer onboarding.

- CLI Tooling for Support Integration: Designed and built a Python-based CLI tool to automate service integration with an internal support system, reducing onboarding friction and increasing developer productivity.

- LMS Campaign Manager Benchmarking: Led end-to-end development of benchmarking infrastructure for LinkedIn Marketing Services, including backend architecture, product requirements, and deployment strategy—empowering internal and external teams to track performance metrics with confidence.

- Authorization Standards Migration: Spearheaded the migration of LMS’s highest-traffic API endpoint to a new company-wide authorization framework, coordinating across multiple teams and services to ensure compliance and maintain uptime.

- Tech Talks & Developer Outreach: Led REACH Tech Talks program - curating technical content, scheduling speakers, and generating outreach materials to boost internal developer awareness and community engagement.

- Team Processes: Designed and advocated for effective team processes

positions.title: Black Inclusion Group (BIG) South Bay Co-Lead
Partnerships Manager
positions.description:
Technologies and Tools:
- Salesforce
- HubSpot
- Email Marketing Platforms
- Google Suite
- Event Planning Tools
- Slack

Key Concepts:
- Developer Outreach, Technical Evangelism, Brand Awareness
- Community Building, Event Facilitation
- Go-To-Market Strategy
- Stakeholder Management, Partner Enablement
- Cross-Functional Collaboration

Major Projects & Contributions:

- Developer & Partner Programming: Designed and executed joint programming with technical teams at companies like GitHub, Uber, Facebook, Twitter, and MongoDB - including hackathons, CTO roundtables, and engineering leadership panels - to promote both partner visibility and community skill-building.

- Fundraising & Strategic Partnerships: Facilitated $2M in funding through inbound and outbound partner development efforts, collaborating with 20+ top tech firms and VC partners to support the growth of a national community of 500+ Black software engineers.

- End-to-End Event Execution: Owned logistics, content creation, and facilitation for high-impact technical and community events, including executive-level conversations and grassroots-led tech talks that amplified developer voices.

- Technical Storytelling & Brand Representation: Represented /dev/color at industry conferences and partner events, crafting compelling narratives that bridged engineering innovation and community mission.

- Cross-Team Collaboration: Partnered with program and engineering teams to design experiences that integrated community development and partner value, directly influencing program content and strategic positioning.

positions.title: Business Development
positions.description:
Technologies and Tools:
- Email Marketing Platforms, Mailchimp
- CRM Systems, Salesforce
- Google Suite
- Slack
- Asana, Airtable

Key Concepts:
- Business Development, Pipeline Development & Management
- Lead Qualification & Outreach Strategy, Donor & Partner Relationship Management 
- Developer Community Engagement, Technical Storytelling
- Program Strategy, Cross-Functional Collaboration, Stakeholder Communication
- Outreach Campaigns, Content Creation

Major Projects & Contributions:

- Community Growth & Engagement: Maintained and nurtured relationships with over 1100 company partner contacts and 300+ community members through strategic communications, outreach campaigns, and direct engagement across platforms like Slack and email.

- Marketing & Messaging Strategy: Led end-to-end execution of community engagement efforts including monthly newsletters, campaign planning, and Code2040 Community Slack channel facilitation - strengthening member retention and brand cohesion.

- Fundraising & Pipeline Development: Managed inbound and outbound development efforts resulting in $195K in closed funding and support for an $840K total opportunity pipeline across mission-aligned corporate partners.

- Workshop Facilitation & Content Creation: Co-designed and facilitated Oratory Glory: Storytelling for Change, an interactive workshop series to equip technologists with narrative tools for advocacy, leadership, and change-making.

- Cross-Team Strategy & Feedback Integration: Acted as a key liaison between student programs and funders, delivering insights from community feedback to inform program improvements and partner engagement strategies.

positions.title: Primary Care Sales Representative II
positions.description:
Managed a geographic territory spanning 375 miles containing 200+ generalist and specialty physicians to consistently exceed performance objectives, target key customers, and maintain long-term relationships

•Earned Gold Cup (top 10% out of national sales reps) with Movantik, Savaysa, Welchol products. FY 2015
•Ranked #17 of 923 national representatives for Movantik lead and Savaysa. Q4, FY2015
•Finished #3 of 32 representatives, Hypertension Hub Showdown Contest. Q3, FY 2014
•Finished #14 of 104 representatives, Welchol Sprint to The Finish Contest. Q3, FY 2013
•Finished #33 of 143 representatives, The Path to $700M Contest. Q3, FY2013

positions.title: Student Finance Committee-Officer Position-Events Coordinator
positions.description:
Worked on a seven-person committee to review budget proposals and allocate nearly 1 million dollars in Student Activity Funds to over 150 student organizations.
•Coordinated discussion forums to increase communication and understanding between the finance committee and students.

honors.title: Bill and Melinda Gates Millennium Scholarship
honors.description: Awarded full funding for Undergraduate, Graduate, and Doctoral (Ph.D.) programs, based on exemplary academic achievement, community involvement.

honors.title: MKC San Diego Foundation Scholarship
honors.description: Awarded local scholarship for outstanding low income, first generation college students.

volunteerExperiences.description: Post-Hurricane Katrina reconstruction work: caulking, painting, insulating, dry walling, and (urban) gardening
